opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance; must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited or examined, or a Charity Commission annual return).
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines. Operating/core cost grants generally support around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget; capital and project grants tend to be approximately 10-20% of costs (local community capital projects typically up to £30,000).

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs, the organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. For capital or project costs, the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million (regardless of organisation's income). Must be a UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation with at least one year's accounts.
opportunities.summary: Major grants of £100,000 and over for capital/project costs or core costs, considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applicants submit an Expression of Interest all year round (no deadlines), reviewed on a rolling basis; if taken forward they are invited to submit a full proposal.
